# Emre Ozgurler

> Electronics engineer turned sales professional in Portland, Oregon. Ten years in technical sales across IT, SaaS, and AI. Builds go-to-market systems (signal-based prospecting, outbound email infrastructure, AI workflows) and helps small and mid-sized businesses with AI implementation, CRM selection and migration, managed IT, and websites.

Site: https://www.emreozgurler.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/emre-ozgurler
Location: Portland, OR, United States

## What I do

- AI implementation and automation for small businesses: finding repetitive work and replacing it with assistants and workflows that keep a human on the send button
- CRM selection and migration (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Microsoft Dynamics)
- Managed IT services: cybersecurity, cloud, licensing, support
- Website design and modernization
- Go-to-market systems: signal-based prospecting, outbound email infrastructure, AI receptionist prospecting

## Free tool

- [AI readiness and discovery check](https://www.emreozgurler.com/ai-readiness.html): seven questions, a short written brief, and a score for how discoverable a business is to AI assistants

## Products I built

- İK SoruCevap (https://agiturk.com): HR document Q&A assistant on a self-hosted model, for companies in Turkey
- Dünyada Türk (https://dunyadaturk.com): bilingual community forum for the Turkish diaspora
- Debutya (https://debutya.com): community forum for Turkish pop music fans
- Soda Pop 1, 2, 3 and Clap! Clap!: mobile games on Google Play and the App Store
